idea: MineVibe is an AI-powered tool that ingests vibration signals from critical rotating mining equipment and outputs clear, jargon-free diagnosis and repair guides in the technician's language.

selected_gap.title: Mining-Specific Natural Language Vibration Diagnosis
selected_gap.pain: Maintenance teams struggle to translate complex vibration data and dashboards into actionable maintenance decisions, leading to delayed responses and reliance on scarce expert analysts.
selected_gap.why_now: Advances in NLP make it technically feasible to generate domain-specific, clear recommendations, while established mining vibration providers (e.g., Bently Nevada) still rely on rule-based outputs and pure-play AI startups (e.g., Augury) are just beginning to enter mining.
selected_gap.evidence_needed: Customer discovery with mining maintenance managers to quantify time lost interpreting data and gauge willingness to pay for explainable NLP outputs; competitive analysis of Augury's mining traction.
selected_gap.risk: Augury accelerates mining deployment with its strong NLP and funding; incumbents may add NLP features to existing dashboards.

idea: We provide an AI-driven, natural-language vibration diagnosis tool exclusively for SAG mill gearbox bearings in copper mines. It ingests raw accelerometer data from the gearbox, classifies specific fault types, and instantly generates a plain-language triage report tailored to the shift maintenance lead—no vibration analysis certification needed.
